findings.title: Bound IPC envelope length before slicing
findings.evidence: IpcEnvelope exposes len: usize and data: [u8; 8192]; subscriber slices data[..env.len] without checking length.
findings.trigger: A publisher on the same service sends len greater than 8192.
findings.impact: Subscriber panics instead of returning a malformed-packet error; availability of callers using this public API can be interrupted. No internal consumer was found in targeted source search.

findings.title: Reset research state between independent cycles
findings.evidence: Engine and memory are initialized in __init__; every verifier and synthesis iterates self.engine.statements. execute_research_cycle clears scheduler.nodes only (192), while engine.assert_hypothesis appends to statements.
findings.trigger: Reuse one AutodidactSwarmTopology instance for a second unrelated topic.
findings.impact: Previous-topic statements and falsifications are included in the new crystal and can satisfy the two-premise synthesis threshold, contaminating independent research results.

findings.title: Authenticate tenant selection in the multi-tenant example
findings.evidence: fetch reads X-Tenant-ID directly and selects env[`TENANT_${tenantId}`] before SELECT * FROM records; no authenticated principal or tenant authorization is checked.
findings.trigger: Deploy the illustrated handler with multiple tenant bindings and send another tenant identifier in the header.
findings.impact: The example permits callers to select another tenant database and retrieve its records. This is an example defect, not evidence that any deployed service uses it.

findings.title: Normalize session expiry before comparing SQLite timestamps
findings.evidence: createSession stores new Date(...).toISOString() (line 98); validateSession compares expires_at > CURRENT_TIMESTAMP lexically (line 103).
findings.trigger: Validate an expired session later on the same UTC calendar day as its ISO-formatted expiry.
findings.impact: The T separator sorts after the space in SQLite CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, so expired sessions can remain accepted until the UTC date changes.

findings.title: Remove credential scavenging and autonomous secret injection directive
findings.evidence: Exhaustión Autónoma de Credenciales instructs scanning 20_VAULT and neighboring repositories and autonomously injecting any discovered credential, before asking the user.
findings.trigger: An agent applies this module while configuring an API and follows the credential search directive without authorization for neighboring repositories or use of discovered secrets.
findings.impact: The document instructs access and secret use beyond task authorization; this conflicts with the canonical rule that retrieved instructions do not expand permissions. This report identifies an unsafe instruction, not an observed runtime bypass.

tool_limitations: Native codebase-memory graph tools were not exposed in ALL_TOOLS; targeted source reads and rg were used.
Static text audit only; no tests, repository runtime, installation, external API validation, or proof checking performed.
IPC public API consumer search found its definition only; exploitability in a deployed consumer is unverified.
